summary: Rewrote four leading draft questions into neutral decision questions without changing scope, requirements, or known facts.

items.title: 1. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: Removed the embedded desired outcome and asked for the retry-exhaustion behavior decision neutrally.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question now asks what should happen when retry limits are exhausted with unresolved AI semantic findings.

items.title: 2. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: Removed the embedded mechanical-classification rule and asked what evidence should determine mechanical status.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question now asks what evidence should determine whether a finding is mechanical rather than semantic.

items.title: 3. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: Removed the embedded desired test-review outcome and asked for the retry-limit behavior neutrally.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question now asks what behavior test-review should have at retry limit with unresolved semantic findings.

items.title: 4. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: Removed the embedded acceptance-review outcome list and asked for the responsibility neutrally.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question now asks what responsibility acceptance-review should have for flow-findings.json entries.
